scope: All reconciled non-fork repositories; assess each existing implementation before changes
unsupportedBehavior: BLOCKED_WITH_REASON; never silently substitute an incompatible chain or claim an integration exists
applicability: Every capability is assessed; any NOT_APPLICABLE disposition requires an explicit justification and review
completionRule: Source-bound behavior tests and applicable live integration evidence, not dependency presence or README text
spendingPolicy: No paid infrastructure, mainnet funds, production minting or ICP cycles before genuine technical gates and concrete release approval

capabilities.acceptance: Expected network identity, timeouts, bounded responses, failover/finality and secret-safe server configuration
Versioned challenge, verification AND settlement, exact resource/amount/network/recipient binding, replay rejection and discovery
Bounded deterministic B3/S23 state with still-life, oscillator, glider, boundary and snapshot tests; no consensus/security claim
Explicit identity, authorization and interoperability protocols; Web4 label alone earns no evidence
Reviewed implementation, official-vector provenance, tamper/wrong-key tests and honest off-chain/on-chain scope
Version/license review, bounded patch experiments, actual before/after metrics, regression and human release controls
Authorized source/runtime analysis using supported documented interfaces and evidence-linked findings
Provider abstraction, authenticated sessions, prompt-injection tests, tool/budget limits, evaluations and recovery
Defined token utility and supply policy; uncapped lifetime issuance uses finite mint amounts, emission limits, roles, governance and supply accounting
Chain-native templates, role checks, vesting/distribution, simulation, source verification and release approval
Native connectors, account/network changes, signed challenge replay/expiry rejection and validated payment QR contents
Environment/secret-manager injection, least privilege, rotation, separation and no secret values in code, bundles or logs
Pinned dependencies, minimum permissions, reviewed repair PRs and all affected tests; no automatic relaxation of gates
Actual supported-language CodeQL plus native analyzers; nonempty smoke/sanity/regression/integration/negative suites and source-bound logs
Observed health/alerts, safe logs, SLO ownership, load evidence and tested restore/rollback
Compatible runtime, reproducible artifact/source match, genuine testnet product workflow and approved mainnet budget followed by post-release verification
